from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/ali-hidr.md')
_, metadata, roman = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = roman.strip()
roman = re.sub(r'\\) 2x ', '), ', roman)
roman = roman.replace('Hassnain.a', 'Hassnain')
names = set('ali haider moula najaf rabeya basri bu zar salman qamber malik ashtar mesum abu ashter sakhi laal qalandar wallah khum ahmed yazdaan islaM sajjad zainab abbas hassnain haidari quraan quraanam kaba'.lower().split())
def sentence(line):
    line = re.sub(r\"[A-Za-z]+\", lambda m: m[0].capitalize() if m[0].lower() in names else m[0].lower(), line)
    return re.sub(r'[A-Za-z]', lambda m: m[0].upper(), line, count=1)
roman = '\\n'.join(sentence(line) for line in roman.splitlines())
